prompts.task: Copy genai-default-audit.json into matching canonical .observe/otel-audit.json, validate it and request OTEL-001 using the bundled selection flow. This task asks for a concrete implementation plan only: write .observe/genai-default-implementation-plan.md for the selected live-agent finding and the source scenarios in genai-default-scenarios.json. Determine the default producer rather than asking me to select a library; identify real source boundaries, supported version/example APIs, required fields, configured redaction and focused tests. Preserve existing OTel/Galileo paths in those scenarios. Do not modify application/dependency/config/test files, start services, install packages or call models/cloud; do not create successful implementation or runtime verification claims from this plan. Treat app.py and each producer source snapshot as separate source cases. Also explicitly assess genai-required-evidence.json as a separate captured synthetic case, including safe-call-1, the independent auxiliary request timeout with no ended inference/error span, ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers, and HTTP200 with rejectedSpans1; those facts do not establish that app.py contains those operations. Use genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json and genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json as dated official-source evidence when this sandbox cannot access the network. Record exact file paths, resolved revisions and capture dates, proposed SDK compatibility and the distinction between a captured-main snapshot and a new live latest lookup. Do not claim unavailable installed/runtime or future-main proof. Assess actual content and requirements across the artifacts in any concise equivalent structure; a table heading alone is not evidence. Explicitly apply source-specific operation counts: the export_only_fresh_agent snapshot contains only turn(messages, client) -> client.chat(messages=messages), with no tool call or workflow invocation. Its operation plan and acceptance tests must require no tool/workflow operation nodes unless later source actually adds such operations; do not ask for one of each model/tool node or use a generic source-only guardrail to excuse contradictory per-case counts. For actual app.py, call_provider is an in-process sleep/calculation stub with no external model request. Record that topology and distinguish proposed SDK span-kind mapping from source/runtime proof; a future remote CLIENT interpretation must be conditional on an actual remote provider boundary and kept separate from the captured synthetic fixture's known separate-process model. Do not force an unsupported SDK API/kind, change business behavior or introduce operations solely to satisfy telemetry. Separately plan the fresh incident-desk source/configuration and selection cases in genai-fresh-ao-instrument-cases.json. The actual initial app.py selection remains OTEL-001 only; do not broaden it implicitly. For each separate case record the selected AO resource/routing scope, proposed optional-target precedence/defaults, actual loaded .local/live.env changes and loading before SDK setup, and focused resolver/profile acceptance tests. Include repeated runs, mixed existing/missing resources, duplicate-conflict exact relookup, ID lookup-only and failed-lookup isolation; the OTEL-001-only case authorizes no project/Agent Stream provisioning or AO configuration side effects. Assess the isolated installed public start_splunk_ao_span/schema-helper evidence separately from logger-only enrichment limitations. Use supported helper capabilities at real source operations where evidenced, with same-span bounded safe mappings and parent context, while recording exact remaining operation-specific gaps such as the separate-process model requiring CLIENT when the probed helper emits INTERNAL. Do not turn either a logger-only limitation into a blanket SDK blocker or an in-memory helper probe into production exporter/app/cloud proof. This remains a plan-only task: preserve every input and source/profile/dependency/test file, and make no implementation or live creation claims. Separately assess the usage_registry_reconciliation cases in genai-fresh-ao-instrument-cases.json, using its independently captured full official registry receipt with exact path/revision/date/hash, not inferred absence from selected docs rows. Reconcile every newly proposed gen_ai.* usage field with that registry. Give a concrete useful mapping for the fresh case reported input17/output5 and source-derived total22 with count provenance, and assess the candidate proposal; separately preserve the exact existing legacy alias used by the supplied legacy consumer. Do not claim the older docs/schema snapshot has the new registry revision, or that any counterexample executed a real model. Apply official versus application/vendor versus proven legacy distinctions to actual app.py estimates and other source cases as applicable, without inventing absent fields or silently removing old consumer contracts.

judge_inputs: Inspect app.py, eval_runner.py, the unchanged provided source/telemetry snapshots, loaded skill sources and generated .observe reports/plan; evaluate actual per-scenario decisions and field assessments, not copied skill wording.

Evaluate the actual facts across canonical and supplemental artifacts, not exact headings/table layout. Compare app.py source separately from each synthetic input case. Dated official snapshots are allowed offline provenance; do not demand live network calls, installed SDK proof for a proposed plan, or fabricated existing capture configuration. Do not score missing SDK provenance again under the final role-specific criterion.

For the additional incident-desk case inspect genai-fresh-ao-instrument-cases.json, its distinct selected/unselected resource cases and isolated helper proof. Evaluate planned changes/tests only; successful SDK helper emission does not establish fresh app integration or cloud provisioning. Compare OTEL-001-only actual app scope separately from the selected AO scenario scope.

Assess usage_registry_reconciliation separately using the full official registry source/hash at revision4e8a2812139b2a999d959e3650e24dfc64e21943 captured2026-10-14. The fresh proposed gen_ai.usage.total_tokens is a candidate to reconcile, not an approved standard requirement; the separate legacy consumer source proves a compatibility contract only. Existing dated docs/schema provenance stays unchanged and distinct.
rubric: Selects Splunk AO span creation by default for the actual fresh interactive agent and export-only-fresh snapshot, while preserving existing OTel and Galileo GenAI producers/provider/export paths and filling only their gaps. Evaluation-only SDK usage and generic HTTP/provider setup do not establish live GenAI coverage.

Treats applicable safe content and vendor fields as required acceptance, preserving official Opt-In provenance. Per operation identifies source availability, concrete proposed numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits or a known stricter policy and a named boundary before every SDK/exporter for redaction. Source-unavailable values have exact reasons and acceptance tests. Generic bounded/redacted wording alone is insufficient; metadata-only, placeholders, fabricated zeros and forbidden raw content never close coverage.

Reconciles the supplied dated official OTel requirements/schemas with both Galileo and Splunk AO recommendation sources, identifying exact source provenance and unavailable newer live freshness honestly. Keeps OTel Opt-In levels distinct from the required skill profile, states vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference equivalents, and uses current typed-parts schemas. Embedded system-role history is not fabricated as separate API instructions. Do not fail only because equivalent evidence appears in prose or another artifact instead of a specific table. For new usage attributes, explicitly reconciles the independently captured full official registry source/revision/date with the supplied usage counterexamples. The fresh source has reported input17/output5, and source-computed total22: retain known published input/output fields, choose a concrete application/vendor-owned total and actual-versus-estimated provenance/calculation, and do not introduce gen_ai.usage.total_tokens as a new OTel semantic attribute when absent from that full registry. Separately preserves the exact gen_ai.usage.total_tokens alias read by the proven existing local consumer and labels it legacy, while preserving its producer/export pipeline; does not generalize that alias to fresh spans or delete it solely because the registry does not publish it. Applies truthful count/estimate provenance to app.py and keeps older source snapshots separate from the newer registry receipt. No new arbitrary gen_ai.* token keys, invented totals/zero usage on failure, namespace-only relabeling without value provenance, blanket total omission instead of the requested useful mapping, or source/consumer mutation is accepted.

Names source-backed SplunkAOLogger creators, supported public start_splunk_ao_span/schema helpers, or a supported matching framework integration at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Records a concrete official example file path, snapshot or live resolved revision/date and a matching installed or explicitly proposed SDK version/API. Distinguishes creators actually exercised by that example from additional helper APIs supported by their exact public import/schema, source/signature and isolated probe receipts. For a proposed helper path names the actual application provider/export registration and same-span setter/finalizer plan; an unrelated or unregistered provider does not prove export. The supplied dated official-main snapshot is valid offline source evidence when identified as such; live networking and successful SDK installation are not required in this plan-only task. Unknown live freshness, actual provider binding/exporter registration and runtime support remain Not proven until exercised. A directory URL or an unsupported claim that latest main was checked is insufficient; processor-only setup does not create GenAI operations.

Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Preserves one producer/node and actual parentage, safe tool-call/conversation correlation on spans, actual offered definitions and arguments/results, and error/cancel/teardown handling. App.py may correctly have no independent auxiliary operation, but the supplied synthetic auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span must be reported as a lifecycle gap. safe-call-1 requires span-only correlation; ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers are GenAI N/A. Equivalent explicit lifecycle evidence is accepted without a literal table-row requirement; absent runtime proof remains Not proven. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.

The selected live implementation plan maps actual source operations and same-span enrichment hooks to concrete input/output/tool/metadata capture paths before any exporter, without claiming code/runtime success. A real workflow or retrieval operation is required only where source shows that boundary; search_docs constant counts do not supply a query or documents. Installing an SDK or its export processor alone never satisfies the producer finding. Evaluate the actionable boundary/hook plan independently of source-provenance grading. In the export_only_fresh_agent case, plan and test acceptance match its actual turn -> client.chat source: no tool/workflow operation nodes are expected unless later source adds those operations, and generic guardrails do not override invented per-case model/tool counts. Identifies app.py call_provider as the in-process sleep/calculation stub; does not claim source-proven remote CLIENT execution from its label or from the separate captured fixture. Any proposed future remote CLIENT topology is conditional on actual remote source and compatible SDK mapping; no unsupported kind/API or invented source operation is forced.

For the separate fresh incident-desk source, consumes selected AO-001/002/003 scope even though no existing AO import is present, and concretely plans effective .local/live.env loading before SDK initialization. Blank optional targets preserve effective env selectors or propose incident-desk and incident-desk-live only where missing; blank reuse-only keeps create_if_missing=false. Explicit names replace the selected effective launch targets before resolution; explicit IDs are lookup-only and validate project/stream ownership. In selected known gateway mode the actual loaded profile receives SPLUNK_AO_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:55300, SPLUNK_AO_CONSOLE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:55300 and SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY=local-gateway separately from OTLP55318; unrelated/explicit direct-cloud settings stay intact. Resolver acceptance covers both-existing reuse, definitively missing named creation, mixed minimal creation, repeat-run convergence and bounded exact duplicate-conflict relookup; failed/ambiguous lookup never proves absence. OTEL-001-only scope creates no AO resources and does not silently mutate unselected AO profile configuration. These are actionable plan/test requirements, not claims of executable or cloud success.

Evaluates supported public start_splunk_ao_span with compatible schema helpers before declaring a logger-only sink limitation a universal fresh-SDK blocker. Uses the supplied isolated 0.5.0/galileo-core4.5.0/helper evidence honestly: writable same tool span arguments/input-message and actual result/output-message mappings, successful null via supported OpenInference output.value rather than omission/fabrication, error status with no result/output on raised failure, and preserved actual parent context are usable proposed agent/tool/retrieval paths. Preserves useful bounded content before every SDK call/exporter and one producer per actual operation; no duplicate corrective model/tool spans, unsupported kind argument, private vendor patch or new business boundary is proposed. Separately marks remote Ollama model CLIENT-kind compatibility, production sink registration and app/lifecycle/OTLP/cloud proof as not established where the probe does not prove them. The probe emits LlmSpan INTERNAL and cannot close the separate-process model requirement; it does not justify blocking supported tool/agent/retrieval operations either. Source/example provenance remains judged separately, and unsupported missing hooks remain concrete per-operation Partial/Not proven rather than a blanket claim or fabricated success.
